title: Bottle gourd: modeled ₹762/qtl left, Solan → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: January 2022: reported bottle gourd prices at Solan and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 79% of 14 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹762 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 312 same-variety market pairs screened for bottle gourd in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Solan (Himachal Pradesh) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported bottle gourd prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 14 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Solan reported a median ₹2,800 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹3,600 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,050/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,050 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 86% of days.

scenes.headline: 189 km by road
scenes.caption: 189 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹41/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹643 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹457 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 11 of 14 modeled shipping days. 10 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹762 per quintal (₹562 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Bottle gourd route from Solan to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 79% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹76,200, or ₹56,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to bottle gourd
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹41/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Bottle gourd route from Solan to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 79% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹76,200, or ₹56,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Bottle gourd: modeled ₹417/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kullu
summary: December 2022: reported bottle gourd prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kullu imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 88% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹417 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 462 same-variety market pairs screened for bottle gourd in December 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kullu report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2022
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kullu (Himachal Pradesh) both reported bottle gourd prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹1,700 per quintal. Kullu reported a median ₹2,300 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹550/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹550 per quintal, and Kullu was dearer on 92% of days.

scenes.headline: 86 km by road
scenes.caption: 86 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹18/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹315 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹195 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kullu report, the rule selects 21 of 24 modeled shipping days. 20 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹417 per quintal (₹300 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Bottle gourd route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kullu was positive on 88% of matched days in December 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹41,700, or ₹30,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
